name: Field Doctor-Style Low FODMAP Mac + Cheese (Low FODMAP)
ingredients:
515 g Oyster Mushrooms
480 g Penne Pasta (GLUTEN FREE) [brown rice flour]
280 g Spinach
225 g Soy Milk [SOY beans, water]
1 1/4 medium Courgettes
3/4 medium Aubergines
120 g Fennel
55 g Parmigiano (MILK) [MILK Salt, Microbial Enzymes]
39 g Chives
3 1/2 tbsp Tapioca Starch
4 tbsp Parsley Flat
4 tbsp Mixed Herbs
1 3/4 tsp Yeast Extract
1 1/4 tsp Smoked Sea Salt
3/4 tbsp Sweet Noble Paprika
3/4 tsp Black Pepper
directions:
1. Pasta: Cook gluten-free brown-rice penne until just al dente; drain and reserve a little cooking water.

2. Vegetables: Soften fennel, courgette and aubergine in extra virgin olive oil with chives. Add oyster mushrooms and cook until moisture evaporates; wilt spinach.

3. Cheese sauce: Warm soy milk with extra virgin olive oil, then whisk in tapioca starch to thicken. Melt in hard cheese with yeast extract, smoked sea salt, sweet paprika, black pepper, herb mix and parsley. Loosen with pasta water if needed.

4. Combine: Fold pasta and vegetables into the sauce. Taste and adjust seasoning. Portion while hot.
 
Cool, portion into 8, refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze; reheat until piping hot.
description:
Ingredients: Water, Oyster Mushrooms, Penne Pasta (GLUTEN FREE) [brown rice flour], Spinach, Soy Milk [SOY beans, water], Courgette, Aubergine, Fennel...

Home recreation inspired by Field Doctor Low FODMAP Mac + Cheese (~401 g ready meal). Scaled to 8 portions. Not an official Field Doctor recipe. https://www.fielddoctor.co.uk/products/mac-cheese
notes:
REVERSE-ENGINEERED from Field Doctor published ingredients for personal home cooking only. Official meal is Monash Low FODMAP certified at single-serve size.

Scaling notes
Scaled for 8 portions from Field Doctor single serve (~401 g x 8 = 3208 g).
Unlabelled amounts inferred from UK descending-weight ingredient order (each item <= the one above and >= the one below; leftover mass shared on that basis, not equally).
Spoon measures use ingredient density (g per tsp) then round to kitchen fractions.
Amounts above 50 g are rounded to the nearest 5 g for cooking convenience.
Sweet peppers ~140 g each; carrots ~80 g; sweet potatoes ~130 g; courgettes ~175 g; aubergines ~250 g; swedes ~800 g; plum tomatoes = 400 g tins; lemon ~45 ml / lime ~30 ml juice.
Duplicate label ingredients merged (higher amount kept).
Liquid for home cooking: cook rice, quinoa, pasta, noodles and potatoes in water as you normally would (salt the water; drain where appropriate). For sauces, braises and stir-fry glazes, add water or stock gradually until the consistency is right — do not try to measure the ready-meal's residual water.
Low FODMAP: no onion or garlic bulbs — use chives / green tops only. Inspired recreation from Field Doctor ingredients, not an official recipe.
Chives listed in grams to match fresh packs (e.g. Waitrose Cooks' Ingredients Chives, 20 g).
Ready-meal residual water was ~926 g (inferred ~28.86% from list order) and is not listed as an ingredient.
Oil for home cooking: where Extra Virgin Olive Oil was only a cooking fat on the label, it is omitted from ingredients — fry, soften, sear or roast in extra virgin olive oil as needed. It is kept as an ingredient on richer/oil-forward dishes (e.g. pesto-style sauces or high oil content).
Ready-meal residual Extra Virgin Olive Oil was ~83 g (inferred ~2.58% from list order) and is treated as cooking fat (fry in extra virgin olive oil) rather than a measured ingredient.
